toegepas.blok: Drie maniere om klank te maak
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'sorteer' has no object here, so the sentence reads incomplete; naming what is sorted makes it clear.
toegepas.fout: 'sorteer' hangs without an object, so the sentence ends incompletely for a Grade 4 reader.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming what is sorted makes the sentence complete and adds no new fact, since the lesson sorts instruments throughout.

toegepas.blok: Geskud: die hosho en die kokonratels
toegepas.voor: 'n ratel van die Shona van Zimbabwe
toegepas.na: 'n ratel van die Shona in Zimbabwe
toegepas.rede_vinder: Avoids the double 'van ... van' and matches the parallel 'die VhaVenda in Limpopo' in the ngoma block.
toegepas.fout: The doubled 'van die Shona van Zimbabwe' is clumsy.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The same people and the same country are named, so the meaning holds; it also matches 'die VhaVenda in Limpopo' in the ngoma block and leaves the protected hosho untouched.

toegepas.voor: Die riwwe gee elkeen 'n kort tik
toegepas.na: Elkeen van die riwwe gee 'n kort tik
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'gee elkeen 'n kort tik' can be read as 'give everyone a tap'; putting 'elkeen' first removes the ambiguity.
toegepas.fout: 'gee elkeen 'n kort tik' can be read as 'gives each one a tap', with elkeen as the receiver.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Putting 'Elkeen van die riwwe' first removes the misreading and keeps the meaning exactly.

toegepas.voor: kom in baie lande voor, ook in Afrika
toegepas.na: kom in baie dele van die wêreld voor, ook in Afrika
toegepas.rede_vinder: Afrika is a continent, not a country, so 'baie lande ... ook in Afrika' does not hang together logically.
toegepas.fout: 'in baie lande ... ook in Afrika' treats a continent as if it were one of the countries.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'baie dele van die wêreld' fixes the logic while making the same claim: widespread, and Africa included.

toegepas.blok: Elke vraag gee sy eie groepe
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Neem' for an imagined example echoes English 'take'; 'Dink aan' is the natural Afrikaans way to set up a thought example.
toegepas.fout: 'Neem nou twee blikke' copies the English 'take' to set up an imagined example.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The paragraph is a thought example (the 'Sorteer jy' and 'Vra jy' conditionals), and 'Dink nou aan' is the natural Afrikaans way to set one up.

toegepas.blok: Elke vraag gee sy eie groepe
toegepas.na: val hulle nou in verskillende groepe
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'uitmekaar val' means to break apart physically, so a child can read that the tins fall to pieces.
toegepas.fout: 'val hulle uitmekaar' can be read as the tins falling to pieces.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The proposal keeps the verb 'val' that contrasts with 'val saam' and states the intended meaning (different groups) without the physical misreading.

toegepas.voor: hoeveel telle in elke maat is
toegepas.na: hoeveel telle daar in elke maat is
toegepas.rede_vinder: An existential clause in Afrikaans needs 'daar'; without it the sentence sounds clipped.
toegepas.fout: The existential clause lacks 'daar' ('hoeveel telle in elke maat is').
toegepas.rede_keurder: This is a plain grammar fix: adding 'daar' only completes the construction, and the meaning and the rest of the definition stay unchanged.

laat_vaar.blok: Wat elke instrument aan die stuk doen
laat_vaar.voor: Wat elke instrument aan die stuk doen
laat_vaar.na: Wat elke instrument in die stuk doen
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'aan die stuk doen' reads like 'doing something to the piece'; 'in die stuk' is the natural preposition for a part in music.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Wat doen dit aan die stuk' is idiomatic for what something contributes to the piece, which is the block's point, and a reviewer has already kept the same 'aan ... doen' idiom in the klankprent block; the preposition swap is a lateral move at best.

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'ding' is vague and childish in a definition; 'oppervlak' says where the ridges stand out.
na_skrywer.fout: 'n harde ding' is vague in a definition.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: This is a word-choice rewording of a glossary definition, so it goes to the writer to change for every lesson at once and is not made here.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.na: sonder dat jy van plek verander
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'verskuif' used of a person without an object is unnatural; 'van plek verander' is clear and echoes the 'beweging' definition.
na_skrywer.fout: Intransitive 'verskuif' is slightly unnatural for a person moving.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: This is a word-choice rewording of a glossary definition beyond grammar, so the writer decides it for all lessons; the proposal's echo of the 'beweging' definition is worth considering there.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.rede: 'gevonde voorwerp' is an art term (from 'found object') that a Grade 4 learner may not know, and the block never explains it. If it is a CAPS term, keep it. If not, a plainer heading might suit better, but choosing one means guessing the intent, so I have not proposed a change.
This headword is written without hyphens while the matching 'roep-en-antwoord' has them. The two parallel terms are written differently, and a headword cannot be changed by the language step.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: wat jou eie deel aan die klankprent gedoen het
laat_vaar_vorige.na: wat jou eie deel tot die klankprent bygedra het
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'wat jou deel aan die klankprent gedoen het' is a calque-like, vague construction; 'tot ... bygedra het' is the idiomatic way to ask what a part added.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'wat jou deel aan die klankprent gedoen het' deliberately echoes the earlier heading 'Wat elke instrument aan die stuk doen' (the part's function), and 'tot ... bygedra' changes the preposition and verb, shifting it to 'contribution' and breaking the link that 'dieselfde woorde' in the next sentence relies on.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Wat elke instrument aan die stuk doen
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The indefinite article is the natural form here; stressed 'een' suggests a contrast with several pieces that the sentence does not make.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'een musiekstuk' reads naturally and carries the sense of one single piece followed from start to end, so the swap is lateral at best and may lose that sense.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Elke vraag gee sy eie groepe
laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Al vier bly in een familie
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Al vier bly in dieselfde familie
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'In dieselfde familie' is the natural way to say they stay together in one family; meaning unchanged.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Al vier bly in een familie' already reads naturally and its 'een' contrasts with the 'groepe' that follow, so the swap is a lateral move.
